one_training_change: Wrap the existing AdamW updates in first-order, non-adaptive, L2 SAM with rho 0.05
rationale: Investigate a different learning rule while preserving the image evidence and the successful alpha 0.2 recipe. The present evidence does not establish loss sharpness as the cause of the gap or guarantee a SAM gain.

unchanged.checkpoint: final epoch, not best validation epoch
unchanged.initialization: from scratch; no parent checkpoint warm start

sam_contract.norm: L2 over all trainable parameters, including BatchNorm affine parameters
sam_contract.perturbation: rho * gradient / (global_gradient_norm + 1e-12); gradient of mixed cross-entropy before AdamW weight decay
sam_contract.passes: Two forward/backward passes on the identical augmented and mixed batch. Draw MixUp partners and lambda only once.
sam_contract.dropout: Reuse the same dropout random mask on both passes; advance its RNG as one ordinary pass
sam_contract.batchnorm: Use training-mode batch statistics on both passes; retain running buffers and counter updates from the first pass only
sam_contract.optimizer: Restore exact unperturbed parameters before a single AdamW step using the second gradient. Apply AdamW decay and advance its state once per batch.
sam_contract.failure: Reject non-finite loss or gradients, restore exact unperturbed parameters on exceptions, register a failed run
sam_contract.epoch_accounting: Every original training row appears once per epoch, even though SAM computes two gradients. Keep both loss traces; online mixed-input F1 stays blank.

extra_diagnostics.selection: Diagnostics cannot select an earlier checkpoint; epoch 30 remains fixed
extra_diagnostics.class_scores: Report Boys, Girls and Unisex train/validation gaps separately
extra_diagnostics.cost: Two backward passes per batch; estimate around twice the training compute, measure actual GPU time and peak memory. The screen matches epochs and data exposure, not FLOPs.

success_criteria.other_guards: Preserve the 14 non-F1 G2/E6 checks used in 04ah, including model size, memory, calibration and corruption limits
success_criteria.confirmation: Only plan remaining canonical folds after this screen is reviewed

Same MixUp receipt and stochastic mask across both passes; no cross-fold rows
